book.name: 1 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ye embere ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Kurwaza ɨngʼana igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, hanʉ niizirɨ kwa niimwɨ nɨkaaza kʉbharwazɨra igʉrʉ wu ubhwɨndi bhwa Mungu bhʉnʉ bhwarɨ bhubhisirwɨ,
nɨtaagambirɨ kwa bhʉkaari bhwa amangʼana nʉʉrʉ kubhwʉbhʉʉri.
Hanʉ naarɨ kwa niimwɨ, nekeenda nɨgambɨ amangʼana igʉrʉ wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ,
kɨnda ukukwa kwazɨ kʉmʉsarabha, na nɨtaagambirɨ ekegero ɨkɨndɨ.
Ribhaga riyo naarɨ mʉnyʉʉhɨrɨru, naarɨ nu ubhwʉbha, naatu naarɨ nɨrarigita bhʉkʉngʼu.
Hanʉ naarɨ niriija na kurwaza, nɨtaagambirɨ amangʼana kubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwanɨ, korereke nɨbhakorokombe imwɨ munyiisiriryɨ. Nawe amanaga ge Ekoro Ɨndɨndu nego ganyɨrɨkiryɨ amaheene.
Nɨkakorabhu, korereke ubhwisirirya bhwanyu bhutiisega ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwa abhaatʉ, nawe bhwisege amanaga ga Mungu.
Ubhwʉbhʉʉri kurwa kwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu
Nangʉ tʉragamba amangʼana gu ubhwʉbhʉʉri kʉbhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakʉngʼirɨ mubhwisirirya, nawe ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhuyo bhʉtarɨ bhwɨ ɨɨsɨ yɨnʉ, na bhʉtarɨ kwa abhakangati bhɨ ɨɨsɨ, bhanʉ bhakʉhɨta.
Ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhʉnʉ tʉkʉraganʼya ni‑mbisi ya Mungu yɨnʉ yaarɨ ibhisirwɨ. Nebhwe Mungu ɨɨndirɨ kwɨma aarɨ akɨɨrɨ kʉbhʉmba ɨɨsɨ, korereke atokorere amazʉmu.
Atareeho nʉʉrʉ wʉmwɨ mʉbhakangati bhɨ ɨɨsɨ wʉnʉ aamɨnyirɨ ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhuyo, kʉ kʉbha bhangʉʉbhʉʉrirɨ, bhataarɨ bharamʉbhamba kʉmʉsarabha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ wu ubhukumya.
Nawe chɨmbu yandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu,

content.text: atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aagarʉʉzɨ nʉʉrʉ kugiigwa,
atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aagatɨɨrɨ mumwʉyʉ gwazɨ.”

content: Nawe itwɨ, Mungu akatwerecha gayo kʉhɨtɨra Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, kʉ kʉbha Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨhaatugunkurya gʉʉsi, nʉʉrʉ ɨsɨɨmi ya Mungu yɨnʉ ibhisirwɨ.
Nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra komenya ganʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ ʉwʉndɨ akwiseega? Ekoro yaazɨ iyeene neyo ɨmɨnyirɨ. Ɨbhuɨbhu na ganʉ Mungu akwiseega, atareeho wʉnʉ akʉtʉra kʉgamenya. Ekoro ya Mungu iyeene neyo yɨɨzɨ.
Mungu atʉhɨɨrɨ itwɨ Ekoro yaazɨ, ɨtarɨ zekoro za kʉʉsɨ, korereke tʉgamenye ganʉ tʉhɨɨrwɨ kʉrʉbhangʉ rwa Mungu. Tʉtakwiseega chɨmbu abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwiseega ga kʉʉsɨ, bhahiiseega.
Na tʉtakʉgamba amangʼana ganʉ twijibhwɨ nu ubhwʉbhʉʉri bhwa abhaatʉ, nawe amangʼana ganʉ twijibhwɨ ne Ekoro ya Mungu. Tʉragarʉra amangʼana ge Ekoro ya Mungu kʉbhanʉ bhane Ekoro yiyo.

Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ataana Ekoro ya Mungu, atakʉsʉngʼaana ganʉ gakurwa kwe Ekoro ya Mungu, kʉ kʉbha kwawɨ gayo nɨ‑ga kegeege. Atakʉtʉra kogoobhoora, kʉ kʉbha gamɨnyɨkɨɨnɨ kʉbhʉsakirya bhwe Ekoro ya Mungu.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉkangatwa ne Ekoro ya Mungu aragiisʉnza gʉʉsi, nawe ewe, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi atakʉtʉra kumwisʉnza.
Chɨmbu Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu gakubhuga,

content.text: “Nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ wʉnʉ amɨnyirɨ ganʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu akwiseega?

content: Nawe, itwɨ turiiseega amangʼana chɨmbu Kiriisitʉ akugiiseega.

footnotes.text: Ubhwɨndi bhwa Mungu bhʉnʉ bhwarɨ bhubhisirwɨ, Zibhibhuriya ɨzɨndɨ zɨrabhuga, ʉbhʉmɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri igʉrʉ wa Mungu.
Kʉbhanʉ bhane Ekoro yiyo, ʉbhʉgaruri ʉbhʉndɨ bhʉratʉra kʉbha, kʉmangʼana ga mokoro.
